name: partner-conformance-suite
description: A conformance suite a provider runs against a partner's implementation of its API: signed requests in, a verdict per case out.

scripts.dev: mkdir -p packages/ui/dist && pnpm --filter @conformance/api exec wrangler dev -c wrangler.toml -c ../partner/wrangler.toml --port 8787
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @conformance/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply conformance-api --local --persist-to .wrangler/state && pnpm --filter @conformance/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply points-partner --local -c ../partner/wrangler.toml --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm check:leak && pnpm test && pnpm build:ui
